en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Khalid, from Sa’ad Bin Al Ashary, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Al-Hassan Al-Reza<sup>asws</sup>, said,

‘I asked him<sup>asws</sup> about the child, can he be breastfed for more than two years?’ So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Two years’. I said, ‘So if is increased upon the two years, is there anything upon its parents from that?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘No’.
en.sarwar: 8. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn Khalid from Sa‘d ibn Sa‘d al-Ash‘ariy who has said the following: “I once asked al-Rida’, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about the case of a child; if he can be breastfed for more than two years.
He (the Imam) said, ‘It is two years.’ I then asked, ‘If the child is breastfed for more than two years do parents owe anything?’ He (the Imam) said, ‘No, they do not owe anything.
